definition: Proportion of scorable facial frames showing a visible smile (0 = none, 1-4 = increasing prevalence tiers; stage value is the mean of two valid integer ratings).
label: Visible Smile Prevalence Score (0-4)

definition: Representative morphological intensity when a smile is present (0 = none, 1-4 = slight to strong; stage value is the mean of two valid ratings rather than peak).
label: Visible Smile Morphological Intensity Score (0-4)

definition: Proportion of valid facial frames in which Action Unit 05 (Upper Lid Raiser) is detected as present.
label: AU05 (Upper Lid Raiser) Prevalence

definition: Proportion of valid facial frames in which Action Unit 07 (Lid Tightener) is detected as present.
label: AU07 (Lid Tightener) Prevalence

definition: Proportion of valid facial frames in which Action Unit 12 (Lip Corner Puller) is detected as present.
label: AU12 (Lip Corner Puller) Prevalence

definition: Median fundamental frequency of valid periodic vocalization frames converted to semitones relative to 27.5 Hz: 12 * log2(F0 / 27.5).
label: Median Fundamental Frequency F0 (semitones)

definition: Interquartile range (75th minus 25th percentile) of fundamental frequency on the semitone scale.
label: Fundamental Frequency F0 IQR (semitones)

definition: Total duration of complete silent intervals (>= 200 ms with energy < 99th percentile - 25 dB and Silero speech probability < 0.5) divided by scorable duration.
measurement_source: 10 ms energy frames; Silero v6 raw probabilities
label: Automated Silent Interval Proportion (Pause Proxy)

definition: Periodic vocalization duration (F0 > 0 and Gaussian-window RMS >= 0.001) divided by technically scorable response time.
label: Automated Periodic Vocalization Proportion

definition: Duration-weighted mean of frame-level local cycle-to-cycle period perturbation (%) across valid voiced frames with adjacent pitch-period support.
label: Frame-Level Local Jitter Mean (%)

definition: Mean autocorrelation Harmonics-to-Noise Ratio (dB) across valid target-speaker periodic frames, excluding algorithmic floor clamping.
label: Harmonics-to-Noise Ratio HNR (dB)

definition: Arithmetic mean across valid stage frames of the median pixel temperature within the elliptical nasal-tip ROI (30 frames sampled per stage, >= 23 valid).
measurement_source: TIStudio thermal matrix; TFAN landmarks & ROI
label: Nasal Tip Temperature (degC)

definition: Arithmetic mean across valid stage frames of the median pixel temperature within the elliptical left-cheek ROI (30 frames sampled per stage, >= 22 valid).
measurement_source: TIStudio thermal matrix; TFAN landmarks & ROI
label: Left Cheek Temperature (degC)

definition: Arithmetic mean across valid stage frames of the median pixel temperature within the elliptical right-cheek ROI (30 frames sampled per stage, >= 22 valid).
measurement_source: TIStudio thermal matrix; TFAN landmarks & ROI
label: Right Cheek Temperature (degC)

feature_name: Mean Heart Rate from RR Intervals (bpm)
definition: 60000 divided by the mean of valid NN intervals (ms) over the full response (>= 10 s minimum duration with automated artifact correction).
label: Mean Heart Rate from RR Intervals (bpm)

definition: Root mean square of successive differences between adjacent valid NN intervals (>= 30 s response duration, <= 10% artifact-corrected intervals).
label: RMSSD (ms)

definition: Sample standard deviation (N - 1 denominator) of valid NN intervals (>= 60 s response duration, <= 10% artifact-corrected intervals).
label: SDNN (ms)

definition: Pre-test and post-test brachial systolic blood pressure readings matched by anonymized participant ID.
label: Systolic Blood Pressure SBP (mmHg)

definition: Pre-test and post-test brachial diastolic blood pressure readings matched by anonymized participant ID.
label: Diastolic Blood Pressure DBP (mmHg)
